paragraphs: Your team will work closely with software engineers, SREs, product managers, platform teams and business stakeholders. That is the kind of problem I have been working on. I check the data before I trust a model: I audited 859,494 training examples and found 44,369 duplicates, and for my AstraZeneca-affiliated MSc dissertation I combined 14 research datasets so the results rested on trusted data. When my gene models scored 0.807 on training data but only 0.545 on new data, I reported it plainly instead of hiding it.

I placed 3rd at Lloyd's Banking Group's datathon by spotting rare suspicious transactions, about 1 in 200, and in my MSc I used proper statistics, planning the sample size first and then running ANOVA tests, to pick the best of 6 algorithm settings. At 180 Degrees Consulting I helped turn a startup's vague idea into a working tool that is now in live, day-to-day use; the client's founder called it "stable, production-ready". I also built a model that predicts which bank customers are likely to leave, and I have presented results live to client stakeholders who were not technical.
Your ad's focus on generative AI applications leveraging LLMs, retrieval systems and agentic workflows is a big part of why I am applying.
Could we spend 20 minutes on what the first problem in this role would be?
